findings_fixed: Major, allow list not held: the gate now fails any allow entry that lets a command in WRITES run with no prompt, whether directly or through a wildcard such as git:*. WRITES covers rm/cp/mv/tee/curl/sed/perl/node -e/npx/git commit/push/checkout/... and gh. The finding lands on .claude/settings.json. The plant test covers Bash(rm:*), Bash(git:*), exact Bash(curl https://x) and Bash(sed -i docs:*); git add:* and git status:* pass. The real-settings test now asserts the whole Bash allow set (the existing entries plus the owner's 18), asserts allowProblems is empty, and matches with the module's own allows() instead of startsWith.

Major, unlabelled fences unread: an unlabelled fence line is now read when its first word is in PROGRAMS, and zsh counts as a shell fence. text and json fences are still skipped, and a test pins that boundary. A bare-fence `git push origin main` plant now fails.

Minor, PROGRAMS gaps and placeholder shrink: in a shell fence, any first word that is not shell syntax is now a program. PROGRAMS for spans and unlabelled fences gained rg, python, tsx, perl, tee, echo, diff, cut, printf, docker, pnpm, yarn and others. A lone program word before a placeholder is kept, so `rm <file>` is checked as `rm …`. A bare < or > is read as a redirect, not a placeholder.

Minor, heredoc false positive: heredoc bodies, lines inside a quote left open, and lines a trailing backslash runs on into are no longer read as commands. Tests cover all three, plus the jq <<'EOF' plant.

Minor, cut command matched an exact entry: allows()/coverOf() now take how the command was cut. A command cut at a placeholder is covered only by an x:* entry, never an exact one. A placeholder inside a word (`scripts/<name>.mjs`) gives a path template, which is covered when an allow entry belongs to its family. Plant tests cover both cases.

Minor, CLAUDE.md layers unread: the command check now reads every layer findLayers returns, including the root, docs, tools, scripts, tests and site ones. What that surfaced is now fixed. (a) scripts/build-claude.mjs wrote `node ../../scripts/kb.mjs` into 26 generated site layers; it now writes `node scripts/kb.mjs` (run from the repo root), and make all regenerated them. (b) The root layer's `git checkout --` and tests/CLAUDE.md's `bash tests/run.sh guard -v` are now PROMPT_KEPT rows with reasons, mirrored in the doc table. Hooks stay out of the check, and the doc says why (they are programs, not instructions).
